name: gaze-cinema
description: A browser piece driven by webcam eye tracking. When the viewer keeps looking at the same area of the screen for 3 seconds, a new video (an extract from a public-domain film) appears centered on that spot. Videos accumulate and overlap. Each one is shown through a soft elliptical gradient mask, so they blend into each other instead of reading as rectangles.

scripts.postinstall: rm -rf public/mediapipe && mkdir -p public/mediapipe && cp -r node_modules/webgazer/dist/mediapipe/face_mesh public/mediapipe/ && cp node_modules/webgazer/dist/webgazer.js public/
